shared_elements: low-relief carving on a boulder-like stone surface
curvilinear abstract designs in shallow relief
justification: Both surfaces show shallow low-relief curvilinear designs including circular/spiral motifs and schematic face-like or eye-like forms integrated into the shape of the stone, and both use bold outlined shapes with little interior detail. However, A is an upright anthropomorphic figure with a clearly organized vertical scheme (head, chest disc, banded lower body, arms/hands), whereas B shows a single sprawling spiral-and-scroll composition without a legible body plan or comparable ordering of elements.
